column1: # Seconds per test_btx suite, for cost-balanced shards (btx_ci.py suites --shard K/N --shard-costs).
# Rows without the stage3 prefix: measured at 4c7840e9 (release-0.34.16), gcc 13.3 RelWithDebInfo, Ubuntu 24.04,
#   btx_ci.py suites --jobs 10 --timeout 900, BTX_HWC=2 OMP_NUM_THREADS=2, 12 Nov 2026; 900.x = hit the timeout.
# matmul_v4_rc_stage3_* rows: the 12 Nov coverage run at c6f9678d (gcc -Og --coverage, up to 3600 s) divided by
#   3.68, the median coverage/plain ratio of 80 suites measured both ways; they only weigh the shards that run them.
# Format: seconds<TAB>suite. Re-measure from a CI run's results.tsv files when the shard times drift.
